lines: Hi, I'm Philipp, founder of Yoloco. Let me show you how influencer marketing is changing.
Welcome to the new era. The AI revolution. Today, everything runs on agents.
And influencer marketing is not falling behind. At Yoloco, we launched an MCP server.
Your agent can now find the right creators, analyze their audience, check the overlap, and build the media plan. Straight from the chat.
Watch. Find me fitness instructors in Florida. The agent searches Yoloco and brings back creators.
You pick the ones you like. It analyzes them, and flags the two with a fake audience.
Add the rest to a media plan. Done. Budget, reach, dates. In one message.
MCP. Powered by Yoloco. Scan the code, or grab the link in bio.
